item.title: Buffalo boys’ wrestling makes strong showing at state
item.description: OVERLAND PARK - There would have been very few prognosticators back in early December that this year’s Garden City High School boys’ wrestling team would be among the elite teams in Kansas Class 6A.

item.title: GCHS girls’ wrestling repeats as 6A state champions
item.description: OVERLAND PARK - After Friday’s first day of the Class 6A state girls’ wrestling championship, the defending state champion Garden City High School was only three points in front of their biggest challenger, Gardner Edgerton.

item.title: Kelly announces data protection in USDA’s SNAP data request
item.description: TOPEKA – Governor Laura Kelly announced Friday that her administration has secured an agreement from the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) that protects Kansans’ personal private data from being shared with foreign governments and complies with state and federal privacy laws related to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). The agreement also ensures that after the data is shared, USDA will cancel its disallowance letter, ending USDA’s efforts to disallow Kansas’ SNAP

item.title: KDHE announces Rural Health Transformation program grant opportunities
item.description: TOPEKA – The Kansas Department of Health and Environment (KDHE) posted Request for Applications (RFA) for its first two grant opportunities under the Rural Health Transformation program (RHTP) in Kansas.

item.title: Music concerts scheduled at USD 457 schools
item.description: There will be a number of music concerts scheduled during the week at Garden City Public Schools USD 457. The free concerts are open to the public.

item.title: GCCC Art Club to host sale
item.description: Mercer Gallery at Garden City Community College will host the GCCC Art Club’s Affordable Art Sale from 6-9 p.m. on Wednesday, March 4, with an opening reception and light refreshments. The sale will continue from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on both Thursday, March 5, and Friday, March 6.

item.title: BusterCon brings people together through mutual interests
item.description: BusterCon celebrated fandom and fun on Saturday at Garden City Community College Perryman Athletic Complex.
